title: Shifted agreement under a choice word
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $w$ be a finite binary choice word, let $r$ be a natural number, let $d$ assign an integer shift to each work-tape index, and let $c,c'$ be configurations that agree with shift $d$ and radius $r+|w|$. Then the configurations reached by running $M$ from $c$ and $c'$ under $w$ agree with shift $d$ and radius $r$.
hypotheses_covered: An integer shift $d(i)$ for each work-tape index
Configurations $c,c'$ agreeing with shift $d$ and radius $r+|w|$
